news.headline: NFL Power Rankings: Stacking all 32 teams for Week 12, plus extension candidates
news.description: How does every NFL team stack up heading into Week 12? We made our 1-32 list and picked players who could get a new contract.

news.headline: Jayden Daniels again delivers in 'high-pressure' situation for Commanders
news.description: After failing multiple times in late-game situations earlier this season, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels put together a second consecutive winning drive Monday night as Washington kicked a last-second field goal to beat Cincinnati 22-20.

news.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels-themed post aimed at Bengals tops NFL Week 11 trolls
news.description: NFL teams remained petty in Week 11, led by a post from the Washington Commanders.

news.headline: Commanders building momentum, halt Bengals' 5-game win streak
news.description: The Commanders' defense held the potent Bengals in check and Washington has won three of four.

news.headline: Seahawks to monitor Sam Darnold status this week before final call vs. 49ers
news.description: The Seahawks still plan to start Sam Darnold against the 49ers but will wait to see how the QB looks in practice Wednesday before making a final call.

news.headline: NFL Week 11 arrivals: Tee Higgins pays homage to Fiona the Hippo ahead of 'MNF'
news.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

news.headline: Struggling Ravens noncommittal on whether Humphrey will play Sunday vs. Texans
news.description: A day after he was a healthy scratch in a 35-33 loss at the Panthers following a derogatory comment he made about the city of Baltimore, the Ravens were noncommittal on whether cornerback Marlon Humphrey would play Sunday against the Texans.
